title: Nvidia scandal looms over US-China AI talks
summary: AI bots going rogue and humans using the technology for harm will likely be on the agenda when Donald Trump and Xi Jinping meet next week, with the Nvidia scandal hanging over the talks on AI safety. But the scandal is unlikely to "dominate the agenda" or affect Trump and Xi's personal relationship, predicted Dylan Loh of Singapore's Nanyang Technological University.
llm_summary: The upcoming US‑China AI summit—where Donald Trump and Xi Jinping will meet—will likely touch on the risks of rogue AI bots and the misuse of the technology, but the recent Nvidia controversy is expected to be a peripheral topic rather than the main focus. According to Dylan Loh of Nanyang Technological University, the scandal won’t dominate the agenda or strain the personal rapport between the two leaders.
